messages.author: 4cf18bcde281cb51
messages.subject: Raising Likelihood to a power
parts:
Hi all,

I need the likelihood to be raised to a certain power (multiplied by itself)

in stan my current likelihood is defined by

y ~ multi_normal_cholesky(X*beta,L);

Does anyone know an easy way to accomplish this within the stan architecture?

Thanks for any help

Sam

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Raising Likelihood to a power
parts:
This:

  increment_log_prob(p*multi_normal_cholesky_log(y,X*beta,L));

will raise your likelihood to whatever power p you want.

Cheers,
Marcus
